en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate historic complex of civic buildings around a cobbled courtyard. On the left is a neoclassical façade with arched doorway and pediment; on the right is a richly decorated Baroque/Flemish Renaissance façade with statues and gables, forming an archway passage beneath. The layout and caption indicate it is the law courts and registry building in Bruges. The image is bordered by white space, with printed captions beneath and along the side.
